gloss: to maintain; to put in order; to develop

definitions.gloss: to maintain; to service; to overhaul
definitions.explanation: To inspect and repair machinery, vehicles, or equipment to keep them in good working condition.

definitions.gloss: to put in order; to develop; to improve (infrastructure)
definitions.explanation: To establish, organize, or improve systems, facilities, or environments so they function properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整備|せいび}する。
⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整備|せいび}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だった。
examples.english: Poor maintenance was the cause of the accident.

examples.english: I want to develop the area's infrastructure and make it a livable town.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is used for mechanical/vehicle maintenance. Sense 2 is broader, covering infrastructure development, legal frameworks, and organizational systems. Both senses share the core meaning of putting things in proper order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧ (car maintenance)

- ⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (maintenance shop)
